analysis_status: retrospective repair after discovery of support leakage in the published phenological-overlap surface; not preregistered or confirmatory
purpose: Reconstruct a focal-response-excluded temporal opportunity surface from raw dated visitor records, then ask whether that clean surface discriminates annual link gains and losses across held-out transitions.

opportunity_definition.time_grain: ISO calendar week within the target year
opportunity_definition.plant_flowering_week: the focal plant has at least one dated raw observation row in the target year with no.fl.obs > 0
opportunity_definition.pollinator_otherplant_active_week: the focal pollinator has at least one dated positive visit in the target year to a plant species other than the focal plant
opportunity_definition.focal_excluded_overlap_weeks: count of target-year weeks satisfying both plant_flowering_week and pollinator_otherplant_active_week
opportunity_definition.focal_response_exclusion: No visit by the focal pollinator to the focal plant contributes to pollinator activity or overlap for that dyad.
opportunity_definition.undated_rows: Undated positive visits may define the annual response link but never contribute to weekly opportunity predictors.

response_integrity.required: raw Figshare positive-visit link states must agree exactly with previous_link/current_link in every Stage-1 dyad row for the 45 x 135 subset

risk_sets.gain: Stage-1 shared-species dyads with previous_link = false; outcome is current_link
risk_sets.loss: Stage-1 shared-species dyads with previous_link = true; outcome is not current_link

model.family: separate binomial logistic models for gain and loss
model.transform: log1p each predictor, then z-score using training-fold moments only
model.cross_validation: leave one annual transition out within each frozen sampling scope

models.current_full: target-year focal_excluded_overlap_weeks + target-year plant_flowering_weeks + target-year pollinator_otherplant_active_weeks

model.incremental_question: Does dyad-specific weekly overlap add held-out information beyond the two marginal availability/activity week counts?

support_audit.required: non-zero reconstructed opportunity must not be structurally nested inside ever-realized focal links

interpretation.allowed: The focal-response-excluded current-year availability/activity surface may discriminate annual link dynamics across held-out response transitions. Pair-specific temporal matching requires incremental full-versus-marginal skill. The lagged model is a past-only negative control for stable propensity/forecastability.
forbidden: strict prospective forecasting from past-only covariates
true absence for zero observed links
calling marginal availability/activity skill evidence for pair-specific phenological matching

claim_ceiling: This repair can recover a clean focal-response-excluded availability/activity association. Pair-specific temporal overlap is a separate incremental question and must not be inferred from the full-model skill alone. The analysis remains retrospective, contemporaneous, detection-sensitive, and is not a causal or routeability test.

negative_control.name: one_year_lagged_opportunity
negative_control.definition: Recompute the same focal-response-excluded overlap and marginal activity/availability predictors using the previous year only, then predict the next annual link transition.
negative_control.purpose: Distinguish contemporaneous opportunity association from a stable dyad propensity or genuine past-only forecast.
negative_control.interpretation: Failure of the lagged model does not invalidate the contemporaneous opportunity association; it limits the result to current-state ecology rather than forecastability.
